equal_work_continuations.scope: Each device freezes its own native continuation. Equal step count and tensor shapes do not establish identical token inputs across devices.

scope.action_identity_scope: Cross-device action, victim and hit identity counts in this quality review refer only to free_generation. Equal_work choices differ; their separately computed adaptive action counts are supplied only to make this scope distinction explicit.
scope.device_caveat: P100 CUDA 12.6 / Torch cu126 and RTX CUDA 12.8 / Torch cu128 run on different host systems. P100 lacks the matching runtime CPU/thread/TF32/cgroup snapshot; these controls cannot be asserted identical.
scope.format_diagnostic: Expected numeric occurrence is a literal diagnostic only. Some exact-match failures contain the correct value with added text; no semantic rescoring is applied.
scope.free_generation_timing: Free-generation lengths differ under INT4; they must not be used as equal-work speedup evidence.
scope.integrity_caveat: Per-run hashes/accounting/scores are independently audited. This is not hardware attestation. P100 has no supplied outer suite manifest.
scope.repeat_caveat: 24 underlying generated questions, 48 context variants, three repeats and repeated scenarios; response totals are not independent quality samples.
scope.scoring: Predefined whitespace-normalized exact answer, with truncation scored incorrect, independently recomputed from stored answers and fixture truth.
scope.source_caveat: Declared Git commits differ, but all 25 recorded execution source files match both commits and each other. This does not assert identical entire repositories or environments.
